comments.author: V_I
comments.body:
No two people are ever completely alike. Neither are their playstyles. Online games provide a wide variety of choices; if we only adhered to a single method of play, we would be drones. Robots. Not unlike the rolegold spammers, really.

Because we're different, we pursue various ways to achieve our goals, our levels, our ducats, our dreams. Change always brings about complaints and controversy, but in the end, it can be for our benefit to grow... to learn... to become more than we already are, and to explore multiple possibilities. So rather than debate endlessly, just play, and enjoy.

Just my two ducats. Back to seeking that endless horizon. Good sailing to you!

Vyse_Inglebard

PS: People most definitively still sail. Maybe you don't see them, due to privacy settings, or vast oceans to traverse, or even real life time zone differences... but they're out there.

comments.body:
Turns out pets with Area Search (Land) can find these at the Bay of Bengal Northeast Coast landing point. Pets with the Additional Discovery ability have a random chance of finding any items in that region, as well as Pet Plunder (land) ability may also find items when beating land battle enemies, so you may get them that way as well. You won't probably be able to farm them as quickly as in a dungeon, but it's nice to know the option exists. Cheers. I wonder which sea zone, if any, a pet could find this item at with Area Search (Sea) skill...
